curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What begins as a probe into rogue wildlife unravels when the students discover who—and what—the solitary hunter is truly tracking.
curatedMovie.description: Students looking into strange bear killings follow a mysterious hunter and discover that his work involves trolls.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting fantasy-horror with steady suspense, moderate intensity, and an offbeat edge ideal for group watch nights.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This fantasy-horror investigation follows students from a series of bear killings to the revelation that a hunter tracks trolls.
